stem:
Use “Leaping Falls” to answer the following question.

This question has two parts.

Part A
In the poem “Leaping Falls,” the speaker is most likely —

options.label: A
options.text: a boy exploring a new environment

options.label: B
options.text: an adult returning to a place he visited in his youth

options.label: C
options.text: a pioneer discovering an unknown land

options.label: D
options.text: a hunter pursuing an animal through the wilderness

notes: This item contains two parts (Part A and Part B) with multiple-choice options, consistent with standard=2.4(F), year=2023, question_number=16.
